g.text: Process view - refresh in the browser: Web Lock between tabs and silent refresh on /login
Two tabs get 401 at the same time (expired access token)
Repeats the original request first → 401 again
204 + Set-Cookie (new cookies, shared by the tabs)
Repeats the original request first → 200 with the cookies A
Without the lock, A and B would present the same refresh token; the second would be
and the API would revoke all sessions. Without navigator.locks: only sharing within the
If the refresh fails, the 401 reaches the caller (who sends the user to /login).
Silent refresh on /login (the server never renews the session)
